premise: Hiding underground trades visible danger for a sensory predator and rising water. Moving supplies creates the very vibrations that expose the refuge.
cast: Reed: saved scarf/white-circle/black-stick identity, grounded grey school pack.
Mina: adult cleaner, olive work vest, station keys, white head/hands/feet.
Ash: adult commuter, burgundy work shirt then recovered charcoal coat; white head/hands/feet; laptop bag/photo sleeve.
Clatter: recurring charcoal plated quadruped, two feeler plates; use one newly prepared visual identity.
Surveyor: existing saved alien identity marking surface infrastructure.
locations: Entrance/ticket hall -> platform and stranded train.
Staff passage -> maintenance room/platform gate -> northern concrete access tunnel.
Junction: east low rail tunnel; west concrete stairs to dry landing BEFORE exposed metal grid.
Grid -> high concrete walkway -> surface hatch and depot yard -> known warehouse shelter.
chronology: Days1-5: observe Clatter; soft rail/tile tests; Surveyor at entrance.
Days6-10: maintenance, train supplies/map, connected-grid and separate-rail soft tests.
Days11-14: cart falls to rail, refuge found, explicit cart recovery and northern move.
Days16-21: Surveyor pressure, rising water, loud separate-rail test observed.
Day23: Ash breaks recovered cart attempting to leave; burden changes.
Days24-29: supplies moved, handle recovered, hatch watched while occupied.
Day30: tested local-clang diversion, grid crossing, hatch exit and shelter checked.
setups_and_payoffs: Connected grid blocks departure; distinct local clang test permits last crossing.
Ash's attempted belongings recovery costs cart; later shares carrying burden.
Both flooding and Surveyor occupancy constrain timing; warehouse shelter planted before ending.
persistent_states: Cart first abandoned, then explicitly retrieved, then wheel permanently broken; no teleportation.
Clatter detects track signals at distance and loud nearby clang separately; no vibration footprints or mind reading.
Separate rail stays disconnected on rubber blocks; tests occur on-page.
Landing is before crossing, so earlier refuge does not skip final obstacle.
Hatch under original street debris remains unusable; final depot hatch is a distinct exit.
Ash keeps surviving photo sleeve but never reaches apartment; accepts escape rather than promises later retrieval.
visual_reference_status: Use existing preset main/drawing guide; prepare and inspect recurring side-character and new-location references before scenes.
